reasons: Cited Section 13.4.1 gives our side (AbbVie) an express right to assign without Harpoon's consent to an Affiliate or to a successor in a merger, sale of stock or sale of assets, with any other assignment subject to a 'not unreasonably withheld, conditioned, or delayed' consent standard — squarely within the playbook's acceptable range.

No Vendor termination, re-pricing or altered-rights trigger on our change of control appears; the only change-of-control machinery (Section 13.2) runs in our favour by requiring Harpoon to notify us of a Harpoon Change in Control.

The rationale correctly characterises the clause as mutual (so no competitor bar / one-way restriction on Harpoon) and expressly notes this sits at the fallback rather than the preferred position — the right treatment under the classification semantics, not a deviation.
Consistent with a compliant finding, no redline or counterparty comment was proposed; the deterministic check confirming the successor/affiliate carve-out is satisfied.
